name: mock-pipeline
description: The ticket 8.5 proof that two chained `llm` steps pass data between them through templating, running entirely on the deterministic offline mock provider (model `mock/sim-1`). A converted linear M4 chain: a draft step turns a run param into a completion, a refine step feeds that completion back into a second model call via `${{ steps.draft.output.text }}`, and a record step captures the final text. On the mock the outputs are reproducible with no API key and no network, so this is the workhorse fixture for CI and load; swapping the model id to a real provider makes it a live workflow unchanged.
